incidents.cause: The pilot’s failure to maintain adequate speed and altitude during final approach, which resulted in an off field landing short of the runway and a subsequent nose over.
The malfunction of the right brake during landing rollout.
The pilot's decision to land and attempt to takeoff from an unsuitable off-airport site.
The pilot’s inability to maintain pitch control due to an encounter with a tailwind gust after the airplane had stopped, which resulted in a nose-over.

The pilot’s failure to maintain clearance from terrain while maneuvering at low altitude in mountainous terrain. Contributing was the pilot’s inadequate preflight planning and aeronautical decision making.
A total loss of engine power due to fuel exhaustion.
